ctpp.multiblock.kinetic_generator.toolti: The base conversion efficiency from stress to EU is 128:1

ctpp.multiblock.kinetic_steam_turbine.to: A machine that can output kinetic
Each level of the rotor holder upgrade increases turbine efficiency by §610%§r
Steam-type machines lose 10% efficiency for each voltage tier above §6HV§r
Running efficiency will gain an addition of (1 + tier/(tier + 1))
There are other Windmill Controllers Around
Windmill Master Control! The more, the stronger!

-Detects windmill bearings within a radius of 32 blocks around the multiblock. 
-The total stress output is calculated as: Number of windmill bearings × (Total stress output of surrounding windmills + 512). 
-§4Can control up to (6 + 6 * tier) windmills!§r
If there are other windmill controllers within 64 blocks, the output will decrease to 0.
ctpp.ponder.big_dam_common.text_2: Use any terminal, sneak down, and right-click for one-click placement
ctpp.ponder.big_dam_common.title: Big Dam
ctpp.ponder.big_dam_work.header: How to make the Big Dam work
ctpp.ponder.big_dam_work.text_1: You can place interfaces at the location of the stone bricks, such as input bins, stress output bins, etc
ctpp.ponder.big_dam_work.text_2: However, it should be noted that if you do not place enough kinetic output hatch, the stress of the Big Dam will not be fully outputted
ctpp.ponder.big_dam_work.text_3: Now, just by inputting lubricating oil, the Big Dam can output stress
ctpp.ponder.big_dam_work.title: How to make the Big Dam work
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_1: This is carbon brushes. It can convert kinetic energy into electrical energy.
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_2: To provide sufficient kinetic energy, you need generator coils.
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_3: Just having a generator coil is not enough to generate energy, you also need to install magnets around the coil.
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_4: Place cables and machines to export and utilize the generated energy
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_5: A generator coil can be accelerated by up to 12 magnets
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_6: One carbon brush can receive the kinetic energy of 8 generator coils
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_7: As the number of magnets increases, the stress consumption of the coil will also increase
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_8: The rotational speed is also a major contributor to the increase in stress consumption
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.text_9: Similarly, The grade of the magnet will also increase stress consumption.
ctpp.ponder.carbon_brushes.title: Carbon Brushes
ctpp.ponder.kinetic_hatch_common.text_1: Kinetic hatches have different voltage-style tiers.
ctpp.ponder.kinetic_hatch_common.text_2: LV is the lowest practical tier. At 256 RPM, it can input or output 32768 su.
ctpp.ponder.kinetic_hatch_common.text_3: Similar to GregTech tier scaling, each higher tier requires four times the stress.
ctpp.ponder.kinetic_hatch_common.title: Kinetic Input and Output Hatch
ctpp.ponder.smashing_factory_common.head: How to build Smashing Factory
ctpp.ponder.smashing_factory_common.text: First, you need a smashing factory main block
One click placement using the terminal
Due to issues with the terminal, the terminal placed crushing wheel is not placed in the correct direction, but rather appears in this form
At this point, we need to manually replace the crushing wheel in the correct direction
If there are multiple kinetic input hatch of different levels in the smashing factory, the actual operating speed will be calculated based on the highest level of kinetic input hatch
Some recipes also require upgrading using a mechanical upgrade bus before they can be executed
Now you can use the smashing factory normally. Please note that this machine does not produce any grinding by-products
ctpp.ponder.tag.kinetic_hatch.descriptio: Ponders on CTPP kinetic input and output hatches
ctpp.ponder.windmill_control_center_comm: How to build Windmill Control Center
First, you need a windmill control center main block
Use a terminal for one-click placement.
Place an input hatch so lubricant can be supplied.
Place enough kinetic output hatches to export the generated stress.
Place windmill bearings within 16 blocks of the controller. More bearings mean more output, up to 16 bearings.
Attach 128 sails or wool to each windmill bearing for maximum stress.
With sufficient output hatches, the controller can now export windmill stress.
How to build Windmill Control Center
